Select Permission Mode

❯ 1. Manual Approval ✓         Require approval for each request
  2. Assisted Permissions      Approve requests an LLM safety check deems safe;
                               handle others according to the execution mode
  3. Allow All                 Auto-approve all tool, path, and URL requests

Assisted Permissions use a probabilistic LLM review to reduce approval prompts.
They are not a security boundary and may approve dangerous or unintended
actions. Use managed restrictions, sandboxing, least-privilege credentials, and
egress controls for enforceable protection.

1-3 to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · enter to confirm · esc to cancel
